GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   C. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   B. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Lakes as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   C. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   B. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   C. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

11. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   D. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   C. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   C. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

16. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Underground Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Karst Scenery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Settlement and urbanisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
